label: prop:gen3-meson-phi-hecke-seifert
title: Third-generation meson ($\phi$) mass ratio from Hecke characters and Seifert volumes
html:
The third-generation meson built on the torus knot T(2,7) has mass ratio:

  \frac{\mathfrak{m}_X}{\mathfrak{m}_\pi}
  \;=\; \chi^{(2,1)}(\sigma_1^7)\cdot\Bigl(\frac{V_S(T(2,7))}{V_S(T(2,3))}\Bigr)^2
  \;=\; (q_0^7 - q_0^{-7})\cdot\Bigl(\frac{15}{7}\Bigr)^2
  \;\approx\; 7.320.

The predicted ratio identifies X as the \phi(1020) meson. The odd-torus tower corresponds exactly to the strange-vector meson sequence. The \eta meson carries an axial-anomaly contribution and falls outside this single-torus model.
